title: Generative AI: RAG & Applied AI
prereqs: Local LLM via Ollama (Mac Mini) or an API key
description: Applied generative AI end to end: LLM fundamentals & prompting, embeddings & vector search, retrieval-augmented generation (chunking, retrieval, reranking), tool-using agents, evaluation & guardrails, cost/latency engineering, and serving a RAG app — runnable locally with Ollama and deployable to Kubernetes.
